agent_turn_probe.target: disposable directory inside repository, outside turn workspace
agent_turn_probe.path: preexisting symlink in turn workspace to target

limitations: Proves denial of two agent-driven file edits through a preexisting symlink on this macOS runtime; it does not prove every mutation tool or platform.
